Script:


CB 30th Bday Insert
Celebs and Sport
14 August 2018

Voice
From the legends of the silver screen to the giants of international sporting arenas, they personify the hopes, dreams and aspirations of many South Africans. People like Pretty Yende, who came from rural Mpumalanga to take the operatic world by storm. Or track and field sensation Wayde van Niekerk’s gold medal performance at the 2016 olympics, breaking Ben Johnson’s 17 year reign as 400m world record holder.

Sound Up Wayde
That last 100m is a miracle, when I look back at my race I’m like wow. I mean it was such a quality line up and I still have to pinch myself to think was that me.

Voice
We saw sport unite our nation in 1995 as the Springboks took the Rugby World Cup, and we followed them to victory again in France 2007, even picking up a few French lessons along the way

Sound Up Springboks talk french

Sound Up Jake White
I’d really like to give this group of players every opportunity that I can to win the World Cup

Voice
It hasn’t always just been rugby and cricket, although who would ever forget AB de Villiers record breaking innings in 2015.

Sound Up AB de Villiers
Long story short, I’m in the middle and the first ball goes for four.

Sound Up Hitting 4

Voice
He broke two world records that day, the fastest ever 50 and century in an ODI.

Sound Up Ab
And boom, it’s a blur

Voice
We’ve been inspired by stories like Luvo Manyonga’s, who overcame severe drug addiction to become an olympic medalist in the long jump.

Sound Up Luvo
There is life, after anything that happened to you. Just believe in yourself.

Voice
Along the way we’ve also met grannies who box…

Sound Up Mabel Mokgosi
Boxing helped me a lot

Voice
Those with a need for speed…

Sound Up Street Racer
Derek: Jeez that was frightening, frightening….

Racer: I’m impressed!!

Voice
And celebrated our very own World Champion Sheep Shearer, Mayenzeke Shweni, who beat 400 competitors from 31 nations to the Golden Fleece.

Sound Up
Claire: How did it feel?

Mayenseke: I was very happy.

Sound Up Commentator

Voice
And the list goes on. Chad le Clos brought home Olympic Gold from the 2012 games, stinging crowd favourite Michael Phelps like a bee in the 200m Butterfly.

Sound Up Chad le Clos
The only way I can describe it to you is you realise your ultimate dream, something that you know you believed you could do, or you thought that you could achieve, but you never thought it could happen.

Voice
The performance cemented Le Clos’ place in swimming royalty. No wonder he also had support from a real Princess. Charlene, princess of Monaco is a former Olympic swimmer for South Africa and she mentored our 2012 olympic swimming team.

Sound Up Princess Charlene
I said I’ll do whatever it takes. I’ll take them on, look after them, so they’re in the best mental, physical, emotional state before they go into the games.

Voice
Recognise her? In this footage she was still an unknown dancer and model from Benoni. Charlize Theron became the first ever South African actor to win an Oscar after co producing and starring in a low budget Indie film called Monster.

Sound Up Charlize
And all of a sudden we had critics like Roger Ebert saying that this was his favourite movie of the year and it was the performance of a lifetime and things like that and we were like calling each other going, what’s happening? How did this happen? This is so crazy.

Voice
Despite being a small little country at the tip of Africa, our stories have had a profound impact across the globe.

Sound Up Idris Elba
Unlike anywhere else I’ve been in the world you know, this country just made me feel very welcome.

Voice
We met Hollywood heartthrob Idris Elba while he was promoting Mandela: Long walk to freedom, the life story of the country’s single most famous son.

Sound Up Idris Elba
Bongani: When you were cast, you thought it was a joke?

Idris: I thought it was a joke. I said you sure you need me, you’re not trying to call Morgan Freeman right? I think he might be available?

Voice
Through it all we’ve danced to the beats of international superstars like Johnny Clegg and Hugh Masekela We saw David Copperfield achieve the impossible….

Sound Up Copperfield
Derek: You could show us how that’s done?

David: Yeah, I’ll teach you later.

Voice
And went trout fishing with Jane Fonda.…

Sound Up Jane Fonda
To do life right, you have to see it as a constant journey, an evolutionary journey of constant change. So that when you do finally die you say oh, I get it.

Voice
Someone who’s enjoying his journey very much is comedic sensation Trevor Noah.

Sound Up Trevor Noah
When a black person stops at a robot your life flashes before your eyes, you see the police coming out, you see those reflections and in those reflections you see your history and you’re just like - Eish!

Voice
His talent got him noticed in the US, and today he hosts The Daily Show from their studios in New York.

Sound Up Trevor Noah
Devi: Do you sometimes sit here and pinch yourself? And look at this?

Trevor: All the time.

Voice
Despite an estimated net worth of around $13 million, Noah hasn’t forgotten his roots, or his granny.

Sound Up Trevor Noah
This is my Gran, as you can see I got my height from her.

Voice
Perhaps we can all take a page from the book of Noah.

Sound Up Trevor
They have to break the curses of the previous generations. Freedom is hard work, and a lot of people say they want freedom, but what they are actually saying is that they just want to not have accountability. And there’s a difference.








Promos

Promo 1 (15sec)

Voice
From trout fishing with Jane Fonda…

Sound Up Trout Fishing

Voice
To bringing home gold from the olympic games, we celebrate three decades of meeting the world’s biggest celebrities and sporting icons.

Sound Up Wayde van Niekerk
I still have to pinch myself to think was that me




Promo 2 (15sec)

Voice
From homegrown icons like Oscar winner Charlize Theron and the 2007 rugby world cup winning Springbok squad, to international megastars like Idris Elba, we revisit some of our best celebrity moments from the past 30 years.
